entries.title: Data Engineer

Demonstrated cloud deployment and production reliability work is transferable to scalable data-platform operations.
main_gaps: Requires 4+ years of data-engineering experience; resume shows early-career internships and approximately one year of directly relevant software/data work.
No clear insurance-domain experience, which the role strongly prefers, and limited direct evidence of owning data warehousing, governance, and architecture at this level.
